en: The postcard features a historic European town square with a prominent ornate building that has a clock tower at its center. The building appears to be a town hall or administrative building, surrounded by other traditional buildings and a mostly empty square with a few people walking. The postcard is decorated with floral and ornate designs and shows a crest with a high-wheeled bicycle, along with German text at the bottom.
